title: The Final Theorem
description: The Theorem of Infinite Recursion has broken every Adept who attempted it for three generations - two of them by grief alone when it beat them. Elara set the bar there on purpose: a seat among the Magisters cannot go to someone the council can point at and say wasn't tested properly. Solve it in front of them, or go back to the rank you climbed from and wait a year before anyone lets you try again.

objectives.description: Stand before Elara and the council and begin the trial
Cast fire, ice and lightning at the trial altar, in sequence, without a mistake
objectives.notes: Cast fire, ice, and lightning spells in sequence

objectives.description: Find your way through the illusion maze without losing your nerve
Dispel the barrier wards without breaking your own concentration
Work the Theorem itself, the thing that broke two Adepts before you
objectives.notes: Complex magical puzzle requiring all schools

objectives.description: Show the council what you're worth before they vote

notes: Threat: the Theorem's own history - two Adepts broken by grief after failing it. Giver motive: Elara needs an unimpeachable case in front of a council that includes her rivals; a weak trial handed to a weak candidate is a weapon against her later. Consequence: named on the page (a year's wait, the standing lost) but not modeled - the quest has no failure branch. Final Adept quest, qualifies for Magister rank. PREREQUISITE FIX: the value in `prerequisites` was a FLAG name, not a quest id - QuestManager reads that list as completed QUEST ids, so this quest was never available and the ladder was dead from mage_02 down. Moved to `flag_prerequisites`, which is the list of flags that is actually checked; the flag itself is raised by the previous quest's on_complete_flags.
